slides.title: The Most Intense Insight Window of the Year
bullets: Dozens of conversations with KOLs, poster authors, and colleagues in just days
The densest insight-capture opportunity in the entire annual calendar
Applying the Module 5 insight framework here is what makes it count

slides.title: The Problem Is Volume, Not Scarcity
bullets: The challenge at a congress is not too little information but too much
Without a system, recalling exactly what each person said becomes impossible
The fundamental discipline is capturing insights as close to the moment as possible

slides.title: Capture Immediately, Never at Day's End
bullets: Right after a conversation, between one session and the next
Never wait until the end of the day
Definitely never wait until the end of the congress

slides.title: A Real Insight Has Context and Implication
bullets: Not a generic opinion or an isolated quote
A specific observation with context: who said it, in what situation
A clear implication for medical strategy
Examples: a spontaneous evidence gap, a critical audience reaction, an unmet need

slides.title: The Collective Conversation Is an Insight Too
bullets: Themes repeating across sessions, hallways, and the congress hashtag
The most recurring questions after presentations
That aggregate pattern often outranks any single conversation in strategic value

slides.title: Review Every Evening, Not After You Get Home
bullets: Do a brief systematic review of the day's captured insights
Verify each one is complete and well contextualized
Flag the highest-relevance ones for the team debrief
Waiting until the return home lets the original context fade

takeaway.title: A congress generates more insight raw material than any other moment of the year
bullets: The discipline of capturing immediately is what preserves its value
Quality insights need context and a clear strategic implication
Recurring themes across the event can matter more than any single quote
